text:
maria r.: Cascade Systems blocked on private deploy in ap-southeast-1. agent pod crashes on node init loading redwood-net-bridge. go-live targeted Fri. can @ajay or @samir triage?
ajay patel: I'll take a look. what do logs show?
maria r.: short excerpt they sent: 
ERROR: redwood-net-bridge: init failed - unknown symbol: register_netdevice
kernel rejects signed module (secureboot/custom keys). nodes are Ubuntu 18.04 with Mellanox custom firmware.
samir khan: older kernel + vendor fork explains missing symbol. ask them for `uname -a`, `dmesg`, and `modinfo redwood-net-bridge`. do they enforce secureboot?
maria r.: yes, custom secureboot keys per Jenna.
jenna o.: confirmed. we block unsigned modules. happy to join a debug call.
ajay patel: quick mitigation: canary patch to disable kmod and use hostNetwork to get them to go-live short-term. helm snippet: 
```yaml
agent:
  kmodEnabled: false
  hostNetwork: true
```
maria r.: applying to single canary now. will report smoke result.
lucas (oncall-bot): incident created INC-243150 023 "cascade private deploy: module load failure". assigned to eng-oncall.
ops-bot: ticket TK-243150-SIGN "cascade: secureboot module acceptance" created and assigned to eng-runtime.
samir khan: next steps: 1) if canary ok, request temporary exception for Fri go-live; 2) collect modinfo/uname/dmesg; 3) engage eng-runtime for signed-module workflow and marketplace image signing window.
maria r.: canary passed. Cascade requests temporary exception. I'll start paperwork and schedule a 30m alignment call with their infra and eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
